title: Session-local plugin and native hook-event source constraints
north_star_action: Qualify native tool, context, lifecycle and accounting evidence for long, high-quality US-equities research and cumulative engineering sessions.

study_boundary.original_p1: Separate from the stopped P1 MECHANICS_NOT_PASS study; no replay, replacement or post-hoc pass.
study_boundary.p2: HOLD; genuine natural automatic compaction and same-session resume quality remain unmeasured.
study_boundary.comparison: No savings, protection, natural-use rate, default or comparative treatment acceptance is claimed.

privacy: Sanitized returned metadata only. Original transcripts, request bodies, identifiers, credential/header values and host locations remain private.
scope: Source-only candidate class. No native plugin loading, direct hook-event capture, installation, model, container, daemon or configuration launch performed.

supported_interfaces.native_session_loader: --plugin-dir loads a directory or zip for that session only.
supported_interfaces.sdk_session_loader: Options.plugins supports local plugins; skipMcpDiscovery is a separate supported SDK mode when the host owns MCP connections.
supported_interfaces.native_event_format: --print --verbose --output-format stream-json --include-hook-events is the supported direct stream surface.
supported_interfaces.native_event_record_limit: No promise of hook stdin, tool-use identity, agent identity or API input schemas; actual future emission remains UNRUN.
supported_interfaces.promptfoo_carrier: Pinned provider forwards includeHookEvents but only retains assistant/user/result branches, dropping system hook messages. Extra skipMcpDiscovery admission through its declared type/path plugin configuration remains unqualified.

full_plugin_owned_only_admission: HOLD: the released manifest autoloads startup, hooks and skills; loading for one session does not make bootstrap side effects session-local.
source_declared_constraints: Startup can repair default native Claude registry/settings/cache and deploy a global SessionStart healing hook.
Linux startup can normalize and rewrite released hook configuration.
Missing or incompatible native SQLite dependencies can trigger npm install/rebuild and ABI binary writes.
Missing HTML dependencies can trigger detached npm installs. Existing Bun can be re-executed; this is not a Bun-install claim.
Session/error storage defaults and legacy content cleanup are not confined by the selected working directory.

Default readiness scans shared temporary markers, probes process liveness or trusts recent freshness; startup refreshes and intends deletion on shutdown. Source intent does not overwrite the pilot marker-cleanup failure.
Captured container dependencies do not establish host-native compatibility or prove every installation/rebuild branch inactive.
boundary: The observed Settings Docker command-hook integration remains separate from unchanged native full-plugin admission. Direct native system-event capture may address carrier loss; it does not by itself qualify hooks, compaction, resume, semantic recall or cost.

completeness_critic.missed_modality: Native plugin discovery under managed restrictions/trust, main-child hook-input attribution, automatic compaction/resume, cleanup and resource pressure.
completeness_critic.source_gap: A supported write-confined bootstrap/compatible runtime recipe preserving native authentication and defaults; source metadata does not supply live acceptance.
completeness_critic.next_candidate_class: Maintained native session-local plugin and full hook-system-event modalities; evaluate explicit isolation before activation. Independent whole-task semantic oracle remains a separate P2 gate.

coordinator_binding_verification: All named original SHA256 identities matched; independently bound native counter and upstream primary checks remain distinct.
